hero.heading: Guiding Young Minds Through Play and Structure
hero.subtext: We nurture each child's emotional well-being, creativity, physical abilities, language skills, and love for learning.

items.question: What ages does Echelon Day Care accept?
items.answer: We accept children from 30 months to 5 years old. Our programs prepare children for a smooth transition to kindergarten.

items.question: Where are you located?
items.answer: We are at 575 W 8th Ave, Vancouver, BC V5Z 1M9. You can find us on the embedded map on our Contact page.

items.question: How do I join the waiting list?
items.answer: Fill out the online waiting list form on our Services page and we will get back to you as soon as a spot opens.

items.question: Is Echelon Day Care licensed?
items.answer: Yes, Echelon Day Care is a licensed childcare provider operating in Vancouver, British Columbia.

items.question: What does a typical day look like?
items.answer: Our day is play-based and structured with circle time, indoor learning centres, outdoor play, art, music, story time and rest periods. Our Virtual Tour page shows the spaces where this happens.

items.question: How can I get in touch?
items.answer: Call or text +1 604-874-4010, email echelondaycare@hotmail.com, or use the contact form. We typically respond within one business day.
